# bit Tecnologies

> Native, fast, and private open-source apps for Android. No telemetry, no ads, no trackers. Everything is MIT-licensed.

## Products

- [bit Hub](https://bit-tecnologies.pages.dev/bit-hub/): An open-source Android app store with a focus on privacy and performance — an alternative to F-Droid built natively.
- [bit Delta](https://bit-tecnologies.pages.dev/bit-delta/): Pedometer, activity, and health tracking app.
- [bit Record](https://bit-tecnologies.pages.dev/bit-record/): A simple, minimalist screen recorder.
- [bit Together](https://bit-tecnologies.pages.dev/bit-together/): A planned private messenger for communication inside the bit ecosystem.
- [bit Launcher](https://bit-tecnologies.pages.dev/bit-launcher/): A fast, private Android launcher with a clean interface and native speed.

## Company

- [About bit Tecnologies](https://bit-tecnologies.pages.dev/about/): Mission, principles, and the team behind the ecosystem.
- [Privacy Policy](https://bit-tecnologies.pages.dev/privacy/): Privacy commitment — no telemetry, no analytics, no tracking.

## Source

- [GitHub — bit Tecnologies](https://github.com/bit-Tecnologies): All repositories are open source under the MIT license.
